## Automated Tests Required

### S8-02 — Dash I-frame + Blinking (Logic)
**Test file**: `tests/unit/player-controller/dash_iframe_test.gd`

**What to test**:
- Saat dash dimulai: `is_invincible()` returns `true`
- Setelah `DASH_DURATION` habis: `is_invincible()` returns `false`
- Selama i-frame aktif: `collision_layer` di-toggle (enemy layer disabled)
- Setelah i-frame habis: `collision_layer` kembali ke nilai awal
- `dash_cooldown_changed(false)` di-emit saat dash mulai
- `dash_cooldown_changed(true)` di-emit saat cooldown habis

**Edge cases**:
- Dash di-trigger saat `_is_invincible` sedang aktif: tidak boleh double-dash
- `preparation_started` mid-dash: `_is_invincible` di-clear, `collision_layer` restored
- Dash saat cooldown belum habis: tidak ada efek

**Estimated test count**: ~8 unit tests

*GDD ref: player-controller.md "I-frames during dash" — `_is_invincible = true` for
DASH_DURATION; H&D checks `PlayerController.is_invincible()` before apply_damage.*

---

### S8-05 — Shooter Enemy + Projectile (Logic + Integration)

**Unit test file**: `tests/unit/enemy-ai/shooter_behavior_test.gd`

**What to test (Shooter AI logic)**:
- Jika jarak ke player ≥ 150px: enemy tidak bergerak maju (velocity ≈ 0 atau menjauhi)
- Jika jarak ke player < 150px: enemy mundur (velocity menjauh dari player)
- `_shoot_timer` bertambah tiap `_physics_process(delta)`
- Setelah 2.0s akumulasi: `_shoot_timer` di-reset dan projectile di-spawn
- Saat `_combat_active = false`: tidak ada shooting

**Edge cases**:
- Player di posisi yang sama dengan shooter: tidak crash (direction guard, pinjam pattern Formula 1 dari enemy-ai.md)
- Shooter `DEAD`: tidak shoot
- `_shoot_timer` tidak berlanjut di luar `COMBAT_PHASE`

**Estimated unit test count**: ~7 tests

---

**Integration test file**: `tests/integration/enemy-ai/projectile_pipeline_test.gd`

**What to test (Projectile pipeline)**:
- Projectile spawn di posisi shooter saat timer habis
- Projectile bergerak ke arah player saat di-spawn (direction locked, tidak tracking)
- `HealthAndDamage.apply_damage()` dipanggil saat projectile overlap dengan player
- Projectile `queue_free()` setelah hit player
- Projectile `queue_free()` setelah melewati max range (default 400px)

**Estimated integration test count**: ~6 tests

> **GDD Gap**: Shooter archetype dan Projectile system belum ada di `design/gdd/enemy-ai.md`.
> Ini adalah prototype untuk bullet-hell feel test. Tests diturunkan dari AC sprint-8.md.
> Jika Shooter dipromosi ke Production scope, GDD harus di-amend terlebih dahulu.

## Manual QA Checklist

### S8-02 — Blinking Visual (Visual)
**Verification method**: Jalankan game, dash ke arah musuh
**Evidence**: Screenshot atau video clip di `production/qa/evidence/`
- [ ] Selama dash (0.15s), karakter berkedip (`modulate.a` berosilasi)
- [ ] Kedipan berhenti tepat saat `DASH_DURATION` habis
- [ ] Karakter tembus body musuh saat dash (tidak tersangkut)
- [ ] Setelah dash selesai, collision kembali normal (musuh bisa hit lagi)

### S8-03 — Arena Boundaries (Visual/Feel)
**Verification method**: Jalankan game, gerak player ke 4 sisi arena
**Evidence**: Written check (in-session, no file required)
- [ ] Sisi kiri: player berhenti di batas tile
- [ ] Sisi kanan: player berhenti di batas tile
- [ ] Sisi atas: player berhenti di batas tile
- [ ] Sisi bawah: player berhenti di batas tile
- [ ] Tidak ada gap atau corner escape

### S8-04 — Enemy Colors (Visual/Feel)
**Verification method**: Spawn semua archetype di scene, cek warna debug circle
- [ ] Seeker (Drifter): merah `Color(1, 0.2, 0.2)` — unchanged from default
- [ ] Rusher (Charger): oranye `Color(1, 0.5, 0.0)`
- [ ] Swarmer (Cluster): kuning `Color(1, 0.9, 0.1)`
- [ ] Shooter (Rifter): biru `Color(0.2, 0.4, 1.0)`
- [ ] Player tetap putih (tidak berubah)

### S8-05 — Shooter Feel (Internal Playtest)
**Verification method**: Jalankan combat dengan Shooter enemy spawned
- [ ] Shooter menjaga jarak dari player (tidak rush maju)
- [ ] Projectile terlihat muncul dari posisi shooter
- [ ] Projectile bergerak lurus ke arah player saat di-spawn
- [ ] Projectile mengenai player → HP bar berkurang
- [ ] Projectile despawn setelah kena player atau habis range
- [ ] Beberapa projectile sekaligus tidak menyebabkan frame drop

### S8-06 — Gamepad Gate (Hardware)
**Evidence file**: `production/qa/evidence/prana-grid-gamepad-adr0013.md`
- [ ] Check 1–6 semua terisi dengan PASS atau FAIL

### S8-07 — Re-validation Playtest
**Evidence**: `production/playtests/playtest-sprint-8-[date].md`
- [ ] Non-developer tester menyelesaikan 1 full combat run
- [ ] Legibility verdict: CONFIRMED atau STILL PARTIAL (dicatat eksplisit)
- [ ] Catatan kualitatif dari tester tersimpan di file

## Smoke Test Scope

Sebelum QA hand-off Sprint 8:

1. Game launch tanpa crash → main.tscn loads
2. Preparation Phase → Combat Phase transition normal
3. Player dash menembus musuh + berkedip — konfirmasi visual
4. Player tidak bisa keluar arena di 4 sisi
5. Minimal 2 enemy archetype spawn bersamaan dengan warna berbeda
6. Shooter enemy spawn + tembak ≥ 1 projectile dalam 5 detik pertama
7. Projectile mengenai player → HP berkurang
8. Semua existing tests masih pass (no regressions)
